question: Select the most suitable synonym of the word: JUVENILE
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**, i.e. **Childlike**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Juvenile"** refers to something that is youthful, immature, or related to young people. (युवा/किशोर)

 
 
• **Example:** The juvenile behavior of the students disrupted the class.
 
 
 
• **"Childlike"** means having the qualities of an innocent or trusting child, which aligns closely with the meaning of "juvenile." (बच्चों जैसा)
 
 
• **Example:** Her childlike curiosity made her a great scientist.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Juvenile' **is **'Childlike'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3, i.e. Childlike**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mature **(परिपक्व): Full of understanding or development; Fully grown or developed.

 
 
• **Example:** His mature decision gave us a very useful client. 
 
 
 
• **Grown-up **(वयस्क): Refers to someone who is fully developed or mature.
 
 
• **Example:** He is a grown-up now and can make his own decisions.
 
 
 
• **Senior** (वरिष्ठ): Someone older or holding a higher position in rank or age.
 
 
• **Example:** She consulted her senior before making the final decision.
